mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in GDP growth below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of weak GDP growth are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger during actual recessions.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index above 2% signals accelerating supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods of rising industrial production are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger during economic expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising interest rates are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger during actual tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger during actual labor market slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in retail sales below -1% signals weakening consumer demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of declining retail sales are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger during actual consumer spending slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the housing starts index above 2% signals accelerating construction activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods of rising housing starts are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger during actual housing market expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the CPI above 2.5% signals inflationary pressure, which leads to expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising inflation are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger during actual inflationary periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the employment-population ratio above 0.5% signals labor market strength, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising employment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger during actual labor market expansions.
